newsitem.title: USA: Kansas fall crops rated mostly good to excellent.
newsitem.headline: Kansas fall crops rated mostly good to excellent.

text.p: Fall crops in Kansas were rated mostly good to excellent during the week ended Sunday, the state's agricultural statistics service said.

Corn condition was rated 81 percent good to excellent, 14 fair and five poor to very poor. Ninety-six percent of the corn was in the dough stage or beyond, well ahead of 54 percent last year and the average of 82 percent.

Sorghum condition was rated 85 percent good to excellent, 12 fair and three percent poor to very poor. Ninety-six percent of the crop was headed, ahead of 72 percent last year and the average of 80 percent.

Soybean condition was rated 83 percent good to excellent, 14 fair and three poor to very poor. 97 percent of the soybean acreage had reached the bloom stage or beyond, compared to 91 last year and the average of 95 percent.
Insect infestation was estimated to be 36 percent light, 13 percent moderate and one percent severe. The remaining 50 percent reported no infestation.
Pasture condition for the state was rated 75 percent good to excellent, 20 percent fair and five percent poor.
Topsoil moisture condition was rated 15 percent surplus, 79 percent adequate, six percent short and nil very short.
